examples.title: Touring motorcycle
examples.lesson: Dedicated motorcycle frame and vintage fairing, separate spoked wheels/tyres and a rear luggage rack.

examples.title: Harbour launch
examples.lesson: Purpose-made boat hull, open helm with a real seat and steering wheel, navigation lights and life ring.

details.title: Driver Cockpit
details.description: Moulded seat, actual steering stand/wheel and printed dashboard on a two-by-six stud floor.
details.placement_notes: Base underside Y=0; front -Z. Seat back projects to Z=45; reserve the whole cabin before adding glazing.

details.title: Pilot Cockpit
details.description: Moulded pilot seat, hinged control stick and printed instrument slope on a two-by-eight stud floor.
details.placement_notes: Base underside Y=0, front -Z. Control stick is in a static upright pose; instrument slope fills the forward two rows.

details.title: Wing Mirror
details.description: Compact side mirror on a headlight-brick mount, with a real sideways tile attachment.
details.placement_notes: Base underside Y=0, mirror faces -Z and projects to Z=-14; yaw the complete module to face outwards.

details.title: Cargo Chest
details.description: Purpose-made open cargo chest with moulded handles, mounted on a three-by-four stud pallet.
details.placement_notes: Base underside Y=0; odd-width X lattice (use a half-stud centre offset on even-width decks). Remove floor tiles at the attachment.

details.title: Navigation Lights
details.description: Paired red port and green starboard lights on a slender four-stud crossbar.
details.placement_notes: Base underside Y=0; -Z forward, red on -X and green on +X. Not a navigation-light compliance claim.

details.title: Jet Engine Pod
details.description: Purpose-made cylindrical aircraft engine with matching internal core and top attachment plate.
details.placement_notes: Attachment stud body plane Y=0; engine hangs below it to Y=46. Intake faces -Z; attach below a wing socket plane.
